continuation_preconditions: Known reconciled usage and billing within all limits
Verified persisted raw body and receipts
One request per question, zero automatic retries/fallback
unconditional_rules: Reject invalid citations for that answer; continuation never means answer acceptance.
Missing semantic assessment is REVIEW_REQUIRED, never an inferred pass.
Malformed candidate remains untrusted; do not weaken grounded-response-2.0.
Never convert independent-question continuation into automatic retry or admission-lock removal.
scope: Quality findings never override source/request integrity, billing or generation authorization.
